events.title: Imperium is now available in Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Russian
events.summary: Hey everyone, Imperium now supports Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Russian, and so does the free demo. It's the whole game, not just the menus: the interface, the tutorial, the Codex, species lore and every tech, building and ship component description. Star names and AI ship names are translated too. events.title: The Imperium demo is live!
events.summary: The free demo is up on Steam right now, ahead of Next Fest.What's in it: a small galaxy, 3 AI opponents to out-build or out-fight, and three playable species (Veylilith, Throk, Zyyth Azr) to start your empire with. events.title: Announcement Trailer & See You at Steam Next Fest in October
events.summary: Imperium is a single-player 4X space strategy game: colonize alien worlds, design your fleets component by component, research exotic technologies, and outmaneuver rival empires through diplomacy or war. Every game generates a new galaxy - and a new empire to call your own.🎬 Watch the trailer on the store page above, or on YouTube.🚀 What's next:October 19–26 - Steam Next Fest: free playable demo, and I'll be around all week for feedback and questionsFull release - coming shortly after the fest.
